item.title: Wednesday Morning, Nov 18
item.description:
The Wednesday morning bulletin from Gumshoe News Radio for November 18, 2026: Londonderry, New Hampshire weather with the full seven-day forecast; the Senate's final big test on the permitting overhaul, and Secretary Rubio says there's no imminent Iranian threat to Washington; Iran widens its Gulf attacks to a US base in Kuwait; Xi greets President Trump in Shenzhen ahead of Thursday's three-way summit with Putin; the EU proposes a 45 billion euro loan for Ukraine as Russian strikes hit Odesa; futures climb after Nvidia's beat, Target raises its outlook, and Anthropic prices its IPO tonight; Google signs the first commercial deal for superhot geothermal power; Microsoft's new lower-cost AI models; court portals offline after a vendor incident, a hijacked Microsoft developer package, and a Puppet flaw under attack; your X feed; a Portsmouth Naval Shipyard budget fight, Nashua's tax jump and library events; and Voyager 1 reaches one light-day from Earth. Anchor Ava, with Andrew at the business and tech desk.

item.title: Tuesday 4 PM Update, Nov 17
